title: Dense admin panel
intendedUserGoal: Find administrative risk areas and complete management tasks without excessive scanning.

strongFindings.rootCause: Controls, cards, and side panels create high cognitive load before priority is established.
Repeated tiles lack enough grouping and section hierarchy.

rootCauseObservations: Density and weak information grouping are the primary release risks.
mergeGuidance: Merge tile crowding and filter clutter into a broader workflow clarity finding when appropriate.
scannerSpamToAvoid: Avoid treating every compact control as an independent defect.
